name: USL-Environmental
title: Environmental Sensor
summary: Battery SuperLink sensor for leak, temperature and ambient light (humidity per description), 6-year battery.

requires: SuperLink receiver on a UniFi Protect host

extra.humidity_conflict: desc says humidity; spec sensor list has only temp, light, water

gotchas: SuperLink is proprietary — won't pair with Zigbee/Z-Wave/Home Assistant hubs; needs UniFi Protect with SuperLink support.
Humidity is claimed in the description but missing from the spec sensor list.
External leak probe connects via 3.5mm jack (probe not listed as included).
